scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:functions && pnpm worker:test
scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm --filter @bowr/app lint:classes && pnpm lint:functions && pnpm worker:lint
scripts.lint:functions: cd supabase/functions && deno lint && deno fmt --check
scripts.typecheck:functions: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/api/index.ts supabase/functions/internal/index.ts supabase/functions/maintenance/index.ts scripts/eval/extraction.ts
scripts.worker:lint: cd services/worker && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.storage:start: docker compose -f infra/local/compose.yaml up -d && node scripts/dev/setup-storage.mjs
scripts.worker:serve: cd services/worker && uv run python -m bowr_worker.local_server
scripts.worker:models: cd services/worker && uv run python -m bowr_worker.models fetch
scripts.worker:benchmark: cd services/worker && uv run python -m bowr_worker.benchmark
